description: Moves a scheduled email to a new send time. Only an email whose status is `scheduled` can move, or one that failed only because its agent was paused when it came due, once the agent is resumed. It needs the `send` scope as well as `manage`, and a live key for live mail. Returns its id, the new `scheduled_at` and its status.

message_id.description: Sent message id with status `scheduled`, or `rejected` because its agent was paused or archived.

scheduled_at.description: The new send time: an ISO 8601 UTC time ending in `Z`, which must be in the future (400 `invalid_field` otherwise). Left out, the schedule stays as it is.

name: mails_emails_reschedule
title: Reschedule an email
